not_for: Individuals with no client interaction in their roles

prerequisites.recommended: Active or past experience working with clients.

overview.positioning: Master the art of professional client management, from setting expectations to handling difficult conversations.
overview.short_description: Learn frameworks for clear, confident communication that builds trust and retains clients.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Set clear boundaries and expectations during onboarding.
Communicate project updates efficiently using asynchronous tools.
Navigate scope creep and push back professionally.
De-escalate conflicts and handle unhappy clients.

why_now.industry_shift: Remote work has made asynchronous communication the primary mode of client interaction.
why_now.ai_impact: While AI can draft emails, nuance, empathy, and boundary-setting remain strictly human skills.
why_now.business_demand: Poor communication is the #1 reason freelancers and agencies lose clients.
why_now.career_opportunity: Excellent communicators retain clients longer, generate more referrals, and command higher rates.

learning_outcomes: ESTABLISH strong communication protocols during client onboarding.
EXECUTE structured asynchronous updates to minimize unnecessary meetings.
MANAGE scope creep through professional boundary setting.
RESOLVE client disputes using empathy and solution-oriented frameworks.

stages.focus: Handling scope creep and difficult conversations.

industry_workflow.overview: The lifecycle of client communication during a project.

stages.name: Onboarding
stages.desc: Defining how and when communication will happen.

stages.name: Feedback Loop
stages.desc: Receiving and responding to client revisions.

stages.name: Offboarding
stages.desc: Closing the project and requesting testimonials.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Clients constantly messaging after hours and expanding project scope.
business_use_cases.approach: Implementing strict communication SLAs and scope management scripts.
business_use_cases.output: Reclaimed time and protected profit margins.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Drafting initial responses to difficult emails, checking tone.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The empathy required to de-escalate a frustrated client.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Judging when to move from text to a live call.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Always reviewing AI drafts for appropriate professional nuance.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Do not use AI to generate excuses; maintain accountability.

best_practices: Never deliver bad news via text or Slack; use video or a live call.
Respond to inquiries within 24 business hours, even if just to say you are looking into it.
Over-communicate progress; silence creates client anxiety.
Set clear 'office hours' and stick to them.

common_mistakes.mistake: Answering emails late at night or on weekends.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Setting strict communication boundaries to train clients on response times.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to handle clients independently without escalation.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Professionalism, boundary management, and de-escalation skills.

services_offered: N/A - This is an operational skill for all services.
freelance_applications.client_workflow: Applied across the entire client lifecycle.

what_you_will_build: A library of email templates for common scenarios (scope creep, late payments, etc.).
final_deliverables: A comprehensive 'Client Communication Playbook' for your business.

assessment.criteria: Appropriateness of tone, clarity of boundaries, and effectiveness of conflict resolution.

not_covered: Sales pitching or proposal writing (covered in other modules).

faq.question: How do I handle a client who won't stop texting me?
faq.answer: We provide exact scripts on how to transition them back to professional channels without offending them.

faq.question: Is async communication really better than meetings?
faq.answer: For routine updates, yes. It saves time for both parties. We teach you when to use async and when a live meeting is necessary.

faq.question: What if I made a major mistake on a project?
faq.answer: You will learn the framework for owning the mistake, proposing a solution, and communicating it professionally.
